scientific_integrity: Exact finite exhaustive verification with complete factor-generation lemma, subgroup witnesses and independent subgroup enumeration; all computations reproducible. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete spectra are proved only at lengths four and six; at length eight only the penultimate value is exhibited. No all-even-length claim is made. Implicit earlier examples remain a priority risk.
title: The first even-length group-complexity gaps and their recovery in the Thue–Morse word
